profile: MedDefense Linux threat-driven CIS control profile
benchmark_reference: Ubuntu 22.04 CIS-inspired thematic mapping; verify exact control numbering against chosen benchmark edition

controls.title: Disable direct SSH root login
controls.justification: Direct root access removes account attribution and enables privileged lateral movement

controls.title: Require key-based SSH after access validation
controls.verification_method: Verified key login succeeds and sshd -T shows passwordauthentication no
controls.justification: Passwords are reusable or guessable; lockout prevention requires testing keys first

controls.title: Enforce PAM password quality and lockout
controls.verification_method: Inspect pam-auth-update profiles and test pam_pwquality and pam_faillock where supported
controls.justification: Weak passwords and unrestricted guesses expose administrative access

controls.title: Restrict database listening and access
controls.verification_method: ss -lntup and database bind plus firewall ACL review
controls.justification: Billing data is at risk when database sockets accept broad network connections

controls.title: Enable security audit events and forwarding
controls.verification_method: systemctl is-active auditd and auditctl -l plus remote receipt test
controls.justification: Reliable security events are necessary to reconstruct lateral movement

controls.title: Minimize SSH authentication attempts and forwarding
controls.justification: Limit guessing opportunities and unnecessary SSH channels

controls.title: Disable unused network-facing services
controls.verification_method: Compare systemctl enabled units and ss listeners against approved service inventory
controls.justification: Reducing exposed daemons lowers reachable attack surface

controls.title: Harden IPv4 redirects and source routing
controls.verification_method: sysctl -a checks accept_redirects and accept_source_route across interfaces
controls.justification: Reject spoofed route controls that can facilitate interception

controls.title: Enable kernel exploit mitigations
controls.justification: Kernel safeguards reduce useful information leaks and exploit reliability

controls.title: Enforce host firewall least privilege
controls.verification_method: nft list ruleset or ufw status and test permitted source-to-port reachability
controls.justification: Allow only approved management and application flows per server role

controls.title: Protect account and credential files
controls.justification: Loose credential-file permissions expose account data to local users

controls.title: Audit privilege changes and authentication
controls.verification_method: auditctl -l or augenrules --check and controlled sudo event search
controls.justification: Track sensitive privilege and identity changes for forensic attribution

controls.title: Eliminate unapproved world-writable files
controls.verification_method: find approved local filesystems -xdev -type f -perm -0002 and review exceptions
controls.justification: Writable files may allow tampering or persistence in unsafe locations

controls.title: Set persistent log retention and rotation
controls.verification_method: Inspect journald Storage and SystemMaxUse plus logrotate policy and retention test
controls.justification: Logs must survive reboot and remain available for investigations

controls.title: Disable unneeded filesystem modules
controls.verification_method: modprobe -n -v for selected unused modules and lsmod inspection
controls.justification: Blocking unused filesystem handlers removes unnecessary kernel attack paths
